methodology: Malaysia rates remain unchanged from data/rates/default.json. The existing country-specific rates for Singapore (SGD), Indonesia (IDR), Thailand (THB), Philippines (PHP), Vietnam (VND), and Brunei (BND) are accepted as working rates by the user for all 122 items (82 BuildPlanner, 40 RenovationPlanner). Keep each country's currency and rate column separate. Rates are indicative working rates and are not represented as independently verified contractor quotations. Quantities, formulas, item scope, item IDs, planner grouping, and Malaysia baseline are unchanged.
